Who we partner with

Strong ecosystems grow strong enterprises.

AAYWA seeks partners who bring capital, markets, knowledge, technology and policy influence alongside women-led agribusiness.

The journey we walk together

Partners join AAYWA's supported pathway from discovery to leadership.

  1. Step 01

    Discover

    Young women identify their potential, interest and opportunity in agribusiness.

  2. Step 02

    Learn

    They gain practical skills in farming, business and leadership.

  3. Step 03

    Produce

    Climate-smart, regenerative production begins on the farm.

  4. Step 04

    Build

    Enterprises take shape with plans, records and strong foundations.

  5. Step 05

    Access Markets

    Products reach reliable local, regional and global markets.

  6. Step 06

    Grow

    Revenue, confidence and impact compound over time.

  7. Step 07

    Lead

    Women become mentors, employers and community leaders.
